chips: What can you see about me?
Is my money safe with you?
What happens if I say no?

answers.What can you see about me?: Only what you’ve allowed: this account’s transactions. Everything I learn appears in You, with its evidence — and your corrections outrank my observations.
answers.Is my money safe with you?: I never move money without an agreement you’ve made, every move leaves a receipt, and one tap steps my permissions back down. No penalty, ever.
answers.What happens if I say no?: Nothing. Declining is always free here — the quiz, the ideas, all of it stays optional. I’ll still keep your receipts in order.
answers.A person, please: Of course. A named person picks this up with your context already in front of them — no phone tree, no starting over. Usually under two minutes at this time of day.
